posts.preview: This morning, I presided over a meeting of the Parliamentary Standing Committee on Poverty Eradication, Labour and Industrial Relations (PERIL)

Among the agenda items was the petition by the Mineworkers Union of Namibia (MUN), representing workers in the mining and energy sectors, calling for a parliamentary investigation into the state of Namibia’s diamond cutting and polishing industry

The petition was tabled by Hon. Justina Jonas on 23 April 2026, in terms of Rule 217, and referred to the Standing Committee dealing with Petitions for consideration in accordance with Rule 218 See less
